verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a GPU product that ships a software stack (ROCm, drivers, AMD SMI, container tooling), but the evidence pack never mentions vendor telemetry, usage tracking, or any opt-out control. The Device Metrics Exporter and AMD SMI are user-side monitoring tools, not privacy controls over data sent to AMD, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
